text:
sam: Quick heads-up  we validated LangChain runner <> Redwood gateway for orchestration wire-up in staging. Small follow ups before marketplace tile + joint note.
maria: sweet. can we get a short topology diagram for the one-pager? ops wants exact ports/auth flow.
aj: will sketch. current flow: LangChain runner -> Redwood gateway (signed JWT) -> model pool. fallback route to smaller model when quota hit.
kevin: Sales asks if this will be listed in cloud marketplace or partner catalog first. also need revenue share and SKU mapping.
diana: marketing prefers marketplace tile + joint blog. we need 2 blurbs: customer-facing + technical partner blurb. embargo target: May 3 09:00 PDT.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: create marketplace submission ticket when assets ready (owner: sam).
sam: noted. timeline idea: May 1 asset freeze, May 2 partner signoff, May 3 publish. can engineering meet May 1?
aj: May 1 is tight but doable if we finalize oauth client creds by Apr 28.
maria: blocker: hardware partner needs confirmation on model quantization compatibility for the dedicated-capacity SKU. they've asked for a short compatibility matrix.
kevin: which hardware partner?
maria: VectorScale—they want to ensure our quantized kernels (4-bit) behave on A100 vs H100. I'll loop them in.
diana: marketing needs a single sentence on supported HW for the tile. keep it high level: "Compatible with major GPU vendors; contact for on-prem sizing."
aj: also note in FAQ: "Do I need a special adapter to use LangChain with Redwood?" answer: "No adapter required; we provide a lightweight runner shim and reference implementation."
kevin: legal asks for a logo asset pack and trademark usage guidelines for both LangChain and VectorScale. sam, can you request from partners?
sam: on it. asked LangChain for brand kit and contributor clause.
diana: webinar? partner wants a joint technical deep-dive. propose 30-min demo + 15-min Q&A same day as announcement. speaker: eng lead + partner engineer.
aj: will prepare a 3-slide runbook: integration flow, latency/cost tradeoffs, failover behavior.
maria: eng request: make sure we disable any real customer PII in demo flows. use synthetic dataset from eval harness.
kevin: finance: add marketplace SKU and a flag for partner revenue-sharing in billing pipeline. timeline to create SKU is 3 days after request. sam, file billing ticket today.
sam: filed ticket #B-701.
marketplace-bot: Market listing checks: logo approved, blurb, one-pager, demo video, SKU created. All must be green to auto-publish.
diana: creative ask: 1 hero screenshot, 1 architecture SVG, 15s GIF of the demo. who can provide the GIF?
aj: runner folks can capture sequence. I'll stitch GIF.
maria: security check: ensure the OAuth client-scoped tokens are ephemeral and rotation is enabled for the demo keys. ops will add alert for auth failures.
kevin: partner ask: are we planning a joint case study? NorthStar SI wants a 4-week runway to gather results. might push case study to 6 weeks post-launch.
diana: that's fine. we'll launch without a customer case study and follow up. need a placeholder quote from partner for the blog. sam, can you collect a short quote?
sam: asked NorthStar for a 1-2 sentence quote; tracking.
aj: technical note: LangChain runner integration currently uses a small shim in Python. we should publish a sample repo for reproducibility and include versioned requirements.
diana: marketing will link the sample repo from the blog. legal: please check open-source license compatibility before we publish.
kevin: last item: cloud marketplace lead time sometimes 4-7 days. consider marking May 3 as soft-publish and use direct partner page if marketplace delay.
maria: agreed. we'll prepare a hosted partner landing page as backup.
marketplace-bot: Action assigned: create backup landing page (owner: diana). due: Apr 30.
diana: noted. planning recap: Apr 28 oauth done, Apr 30 backup page & assets, May 1 asset freeze, May 2 partner signoff, May 3 embargo lift.
sam: will keep checklist updated: https://redwood.example/sheets/isv-integ-launch
aj: small risk: if quantization issues crop up on VectorScale, we may need to fall back to non-quantized variant which affects cost. flagging as medium risk.
maria: ok. ops and hw will run compatibility test matrix this week.
diana: thanks team. I'll draft the embargoed blog and social thread and share tomorrow for review. :sparkles:
sam: thanks all, big momentum. :raised_hands:
